name: Desirea Kennedy

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-story building with a flat roof and multiple sections|A paved parking area is located on the west side of the building|The site is bordered by a public road with a roundabout to the north and additional parking areas to the east|Scattered trees and landscaping are present around the perimeter, with open undeveloped land visible to the south.

alpha.desc: The front of the multi-story building faces a public road|A parking area is located in front of the building with several vehicles parked|Mature trees are positioned between the road and the parking area|The main entrance and multiple windows are visible along the façade.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building shows the side elevation with multiple floors and windows|A parking area is visible along this side with several vehicles parked|Trees and landscaping run along the edge of the property near the road.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows the back elevation with multiple floors and windows|A parking area is located behind the building|Open undeveloped land is visible directly behind the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows the side elevation with a parking area containing multiple vehicles|Trees are located along this side of the property|A road with a roundabout is visible to the north of the building.

considerations: Vehicle access to the property is available from the public road on the north side, with a roundabout providing circulation options. Multiple parking areas surround the building and provide space for vehicle movement and potential staging. The building has multiple sides accessible from the parking areas. Scattered trees are present but do not appear to significantly block visibility around the structure. The open undeveloped land to the south provides additional open space adjacent to the property.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking areas, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building itself? Is vehicle access available on all four sides of the building? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the parking areas or the property?
